title: Dead frontend/ directory with orphaned eslint.config.js and React plugins — no source files
description: Verified: frontend/ directory contains only eslint.config.js (138 lines). No package.json, no tsconfig.json, no src/ directory, no .tsx/.jsx/.ts files. The eslint config references eslint-plugin-react-hooks and eslint-plugin-react-refresh, neither of which is in the project's package.json devDependencies. `git status` shows frontend/ as untracked. The project structure doc (.aidd/project-structure.md:16) already notes: '[DEAD] Empty except for orphaned eslint config — candidate for removal'. The frontend/ directory is a fully unwired React eslint config with zero consumers — likely copied from a spernakit template and never cleaned up.
spec:
1. Delete the entire `frontend/` directory: `rm -rf frontend/`.
2. Verify deletion with `ls frontend/` — should report directory not found.
3. Run `bun run smoke:qc` to confirm no breakage.
